name: ripple-consumers-updated
body:
The ripple consumers must stay in sync with the new surface (SPEC §6):
- Suite tools `opencode-suite/tools/*.ts` (embedded in `src/main.rs` via `include_str!`): `apg_plan_init.ts` → a plan-`add` tool; `apg_plan_add.ts` must treat `kind` as optional (= the plan itself); new `apg_node`/`apg_edge` update/rm variants; new plan update/rm tools; retire `apg_plan_link.ts`.
- Distributed agent prompts `opencode-suite/agents/*.md` (plan-writer, spec-writer, codebase-navigator) reference `apg plan init` / `apg_plan_init` / `apg_plan_link` — update to the new verbs.
- Root `AGENTS.md` CLI reference block lists `apg plan <sub> … init/add/link/…` — update to `add/update/rm/…`.
Acceptance: no shipped tool/agent/AGENTS.md text names the retired verbs; the renamed/new tools dispatch the new CLI surface. NOTE: agent prompts are `.md` (not scanned code), so their solution coverage must anchor to the embedding Rust (`apg.main` / the init install path), never to a `.md` path.
